text: Based on the evidence from NASA FIRMS, no thermal anomalies were detected within the asset boundaries during the period from 2026-10-06 to 2026-11-05. All relevant sensors (VIIRS_SNPP, VIIRS_NOAA20, VIIRS_NOAA21, and MODIS) covered the asset every day of this period. However, it's important to note that small, short, cool, or cloud-obscured fires might not have been detected. Therefore, while the evidence strongly suggests no significant fires occurred, it cannot guarantee the absolute absence of all fire activity.
